The Dow Market Happenings For Wednesday, July 25, 2018 Posted by admin on July 25th, 2018
Dow stocks at 52 week highs include Microsoft (MSFT) and Visa (V). Dow stock 52 week lows include 3M (MMM).
The Market
Premarket today, the Dow was indicated to open down -73 points.
Tuesday the Dow was up +197.65 (+0.79%) at 25,241.94.
Year-to-date the Dow is up +2.11%.
There were 23 Dow stocks up Tuesday.
The Dow stock winners Tuesday were led by United Technologies (UTX) +3.76% and Johnson & Johnson (JNJ) +2.16%.
The Dow stock losers Tuesday were led by Nike (NKE) -1.38% and McDonald’s (MCD) -0.51%.
European stocks are lower and Asian markets ended mostly higher.
The national average price of gasoline is down seven-tenths of a cent at $2.846 per gallon.
